title: Why be a dungeon master when you can be THE DUNGEON??!?
author: LikeMyGame
selftext:
I'm working on an AI assisted project called [We Are Dungeon!](https://likemygame.itch.io/we-are-dungeon) I've been a long time fan of video games and D&D themed RPGs/worlds/things. 😄 While I've programmed in many languages over the decades (yes, you read that right) and have an intense love for video games, I've never ventured into that side of things before now. I guess I always felt it required artistic skills I didn't possess to bring them to life despite having clear visions and being able to imagine worlds...which is very frustrating in its own right!

  
So, as I've worked with AI, I've been expanding and developing different games. One of them, which is my most recent focus (I tend to go in spurts) is [We Are Dungeon!](https://likemygame.itch.io/we-are-dungeon) You play as a recently awakened, sentient dungeon (probably from all of the death and remnants of arcane magic pooling like primordial ooze that births new life).

  
The problem is that your awakening is drawing in adventurers who can sense your newly awakened self. You just want to be left alone, they want plunder and to snuff out the life you so recently were given.

  
This is the a solo player game right now. It is a web-based game currently, but I put together some offline play options (self contained browser/server stitch) for those so inclined. Only tested it on PC and a tablet as it requires quite a bit of screen real estate. I'm still tweaking and adjusting things. Sometimes multiple times per day, sometimes once a week (spurts, remember?)

  
I'm looking for genuine feedback! (Yes, that means I WILL be checking and responding to comments). The vision and design (through many iterations) are all mine. The artwork & code are AI except for the current 3D assets which are from KayKit (these are a placeholder as I'd prefer to buy or hire someone so the look-and-feel is more gritty and fits the adventurer and bestiary profile photos better).

  
I am working on a Godot-based version which will have PvP...but after seeing another game, I might try to just uplift this version to do the PvP all via the browser..."there are still miles to go" as they say, but I feel it is in a good enough spot to put it out there. AtDhVaAnNkCsE!  
[https://likemygame.itch.io/we-are-dungeon](https://likemygame.itch.io/we-are-dungeon)
